name: web-dark-ai-dashboard-on-monitor-with-person-at-desk
title: Dark AI Dashboard on Monitor at a Desk
whatItIs: A cover showing a person at a white desk with a keyboard and a large monitor displaying a dark AI meeting dashboard with a calendar and task tables, against a pale wall.
whatItMeans: A bright real desk scene makes a dark interface feel grounded, and the contrast makes the screen pop.
techniques: Dark UI on a light neutral scene
Person's shoulder in the frame for context
Very little colour outside the screen

vocabulary.definition: A screen shown in a realistic work setting.
A dark UI placed in a bright room for contrast.
A staged setting with very few props.
